thread:
Eva (CS): Morning all — quick Day0 check for SparrowGate private deploy. Customer reports audit logs not landing in their SIEM and their proxy can’t reach our collector egress IPs. Any immediate triage? @Sam (Infra) @Nisha (Security) :eyes:

Sam (Infra): On it. Can you paste the log-forwarder config they’re using? Also which region / private subnets are they on?

Eva (CS): Here’s what they pasted (redacted):
```json
{
  "forwarder": "redwood-vpc-collector",
  "endpoint": "https://logs.sparrow.example:443",
  "auth": "kms://arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789:key/abcd-ef01"
}
```
They say status is "connected" in the agent but no events in SIEM.

Nisha (Security): KMS denies are common here. @Luke (Support) do we have their KMS key ARN recorded in the onboarding form?

Luke (Support): We do have the ARN. I’ll try a test push from our side to reproduce. One sec.

deploy-bot: Log-collector deployment for account sg-sparrow completed — 3 pods Running (2026-03-20T14:12Z).

Maria (Ops): Quick note on egress: customer network only allowlists their proxy peers A.B.C.0/24 and D.E.F.0/24. They didn’t include our collector NAT 52.11.77.0/24. Asked them to add that and confirm.

Sam (Infra): If their proxy blocks outbound, TLS might establish but traffic gets dropped. Also check security group on collector (outbound 443). Can you `kubectl exec -c forwarder -it <pod> -- curl -v https://logs.sparrow.example` and paste output if possible?

Eva (CS): Luke ran a push and got 403 from the logs endpoint. Response: `{"error":"AccessDenied","message":"KMS signature mismatch"}`

Nisha (Security): That looks like a KMS policy / encryption-context mismatch. We need the key policy to allow our service principal and the external id they provided. Asking customer to confirm their key policy includes:
```
- Principal: service:redwood-inference@example.com
- Actions: kms:GenerateDataKey, kms:Encrypt, kms:Decrypt
- Condition: StringEquals: {kms:ExternalId: "sparrow-12345"}
```
I’ll DM the exact snippet.

Luke (Support): Sent NAT IP + KMS policy instructions to the customer and asked them to restart forwarder. Will post results. :thumbsup:

Eva (CS): Thanks team — marking account health: action_required (audit-logs). I’ll check back in 2h if no confirmation.

(threads notes: customer-facing rep = Eva; next steps = customer to add 52.11.77.0/24, update KMS key policy, re-run forwarder; CS sets follow-up reminder)
